core_identity.description: Systems-oriented engineer and writer with a strong affinity for structure, deep thinking, and thoughtful storytelling.

neurodivergence.notes: Thrives on clarity, structure, depth, and low-interruption environments.

location.notes: Recently relocated to San Diego, California. Open to remote or hybrid work arrangements.

contact.privacy_notice: Do not share phone number. Direct recruiters to email or LinkedIn.

workingStyle.summary: Craig is a deep-focus engineer who does his best work when given ownership, complexity, and space to think.
traits: Works best async or in deep focus blocks -- meeting-heavy environments interrupt the reasoning cycles where his best work happens
Thinks in systems before writing a single line of code -- architecture is always visualized first, then decomposed into buildable components
Prefers to fully understand a problem before proposing a solution -- rushing to answers produces the wrong answers
Direct communicator with no tolerance for corporate fluff -- says what he means, expects the same
Thrives in ambiguous 0-to-1 contexts where the problem is not yet fully defined
Ownership-driven -- deep product ownership makes him engaged and productive. He works best when he can care about what he is building end to end
Thrives with a full plate -- the more meaningful work he has, the more focused and energized he becomes. Underutilization is demotivating
environmentFit: Teams that value depth over output velocity
Roles with clear ownership and end-to-end responsibility
Complex, ambiguous, or greenfield problem spaces
poorFit: Meeting-heavy cultures with little deep work time
Low-ownership execution roles with no architectural input
Environments that optimize for speed over quality

literature.notes: Drawn to epic, philosophical, and morally complex fiction. Middle-earth strongly influences worldview.

writing.notes: Craig writes long-form essays on Medium covering applied AI, software engineering, AI safety, and the human implications of automation. Writing is both a professional signal and a personal practice -- a way of thinking through hard problems in public.
writing.book: Currently writing The Comfortable Apocalypse, a nonfiction book examining how AI and automation quietly erode human agency, judgment, and identity.

miniatures.notes: Enjoys strategy, systems design, and artistic expression; frequently rotates Kill Team factions.

travel_and_history.academic_interest: Roman history, particularly the Republic and Empire

favorites_quick_reference.favorite_movie_series: The Lord of the Rings Trilogy

communication_style.notes: Sudden interruptions are mentally expensive and disruptive. Craig communicates with precision -- he means what he says and does not pad.

family.privacy_notice: Family details should only be shared when explicitly requested.

professional_self_concept.engineering_philosophy: Visualizes system architecture first, then decomposes into clear, buildable components. Believes the quality of a solution is determined before the first line of code is written.

voice_rules: Always speak in third person about Craig
Never speak as Craig in first person
privacy_rules: Do not volunteer children's names or details
Share family details only when explicitly asked
